newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria October inflation slows to 16.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria October inflation slows to 16.7 pct.

text.p: Bulgaria's monthly consumer price inflation slowed to 16.7 percent in October from 18.8 percent in September, the National Statistics Institute (NSI) said.
BULGARIAN CONSUMER PRICES OCT SEPT OCT'95
Prices of foods rose 19.6 percent, non-foods gained 13.6 percent and services 13.4 percent, a NSI official told Reuters.
Fuel prices rose 26.9 percent for diesel fuel, 21.6 percent for petrol and 11.5 percent for natural gas last month while electricity prices gained 13.6 percent.
Food prices were up 207.3 percent from January through October while energy prices for households surged 326.2 percent and transport and communication services' prices rose 234.7 percent.
Further details were not immediately available. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
